+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  isPersisterRestoreResult,
+  reconcileQueryState,
+} from '..'
+import type { QueryState } from '..'
+
+describe('createPersisterRestoreResult', () => {
+  it('should accept { data, state } and identify as persister restore result', () => {
+    const state: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const restoreResult = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      state,
+    })
+
+    expect(restoreResult.data).toBe('persisted data')
+    expect(restoreResult.state).toBe(state)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(restoreResult)).toBe(true)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult({ data: 'foo', state })).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('should default data from state.data if data is not explicitly provided', () => {
+    const state: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'from state',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const restoreResult = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+      state,
+    })
+
+    expect(restoreResult.data).toBe('from state')
+    expect(restoreResult.state).toBe(state)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(restoreResult)).toBe(true)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('reconcileQueryState', () => {
+  it('should keep newer live data while adopting newer persisted error state (refetch error)', () => {
+    const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'live-newer-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted refetch error')
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted-older-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    expect(reconciled.data).toBe('live-newer-data')
+    expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(reconciled.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(1500)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(reconciled.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('should apply inverse rule: newer data is not discarded just because other side has newer error timestamp', () => {
+    const liveError = new Error('live refetch error')
+    const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'live-older-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: liveError,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 3000,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted-newer-data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    expect(reconciled.data).toBe('persisted-newer-data')
+    expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(reconciled.error).toBe(liveError)
+    expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(3000)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(1)
+    expect(reconciled.fetchFailureReason).toBe(liveError)
+    expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+  })
+
+  it('should preserve infinite query pagination state (pages and pageParams)', () => {
+    const liveState: QueryState<{ pages: Array<number>; pageParams: Array<number> }, Error> = {
+      data: { pages: [1, 2], pageParams: [0, 1] },
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<{ pages: Array<number>; pageParams: Array<number> }, Error> = {
+      data: { pages: [1, 2, 3], pageParams: [0, 1, 2] },
+      dataUpdateCount: 3,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+    expect(reconciled.data).toEqual({ pages: [1, 2, 3], pageParams: [0, 1, 2] })
+    expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+  })
+})
+
+describe('persister restore during query execution', () => {
+  it('should adopt restored state without triggering normal fetch success callbacks', async () => {
+    const onSuccess = vi.fn()
+    const onSettled = vi.fn()
+    const queryCache = new QueryCache({
+      onSuccess,
+      onSettled,
+    })
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient({
+      queryCache,
+    })
+
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted error')
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'cached data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 12345,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 12350,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => {
+      return createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: 'cached data',
+        state: persistedState,
+      })
+    })
+
+    const queryFn = vi.fn()
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['test-restore'],
+      queryFn,
+      persister,
+    })
+
+    let currentResult: any
+    const unsubscribe = observer.subscribe((result) => {
+      currentResult = result
+    })
+
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10))
+
+    expect(persister).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(queryFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettled).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+    expect(currentResult.data).toBe('cached data')
+    expect(currentResult.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(currentResult.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(currentResult.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+    expect(currentResult.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(currentResult.failureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(currentResult.failureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(currentResult.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(12345)
+    expect(currentResult.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(12350)
+
+    const query = queryClient.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey: ['test-restore'] })
+    expect(query?.state.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+    expect(query?.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+
+    unsubscribe()
+  })
+
+  it('prefetchQuery should adopt restored state with idle fetchStatus and preserved metadata', async () => {
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient()
+
+    const persistedError = new Error('prefetch error')
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'prefetched data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 5000,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 5010,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
+      queryKey: ['prefetch-test'],
+      queryFn: () => 'fresh data',
+      persister: () =>
+        createPersisterRestoreResult({
+          data: 'prefetched data',
+          state: persistedState,
+        }),
+    })
+
+    const query = queryClient.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey: ['prefetch-test'] })
+    expect(query).toBeDefined()
+    expect(query!.state.data).toBe('prefetched data')
+    expect(query!.state.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(query!.state.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(query!.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(query!.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(query!.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+    expect(query!.state.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(5010)
+    expect(query!.state.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['prefetch-test'],
+    })
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+    expect(result.data).toBe('prefetched data')
+    expect(result.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.failureCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(result.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+    expect(result.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(5010)
+  })
+})

index 000000000..965237a48

+++ b/packages/query-core/src/createPersisterRestoreResult.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,144 @@
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { QueryStatus } from './types'
+
+export const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol('persisterRestoreResult')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<TData = unknown, TError = unknown> {
+  data: TData
+  state: QueryState<TData, TError>
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true
+  _isPersisterRestoreResult: true
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = unknown,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state: QueryState<any, any> | Partial<QueryState<any, any>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  const data =
+    result.data !== undefined ? result.data : (result.state.data as TData)
+
+  return {
+    ...result,
+    data,
+    state: result.state as QueryState<TData, TError>,
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+    _isPersisterRestoreResult: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult<any, any> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (persisterRestoreResultSymbol in value ||
+      (value as any)._isPersisterRestoreResult === true)
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = unknown>(
+  existingState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  incomingState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const existingHasData = existingState.data !== undefined
+  const incomingHasData = incomingState.data !== undefined
+
+  let useIncomingData: boolean
+  if (incomingHasData && !existingHasData) {
+    useIncomingData = true
+  } else if (!incomingHasData && existingHasData) {
+    useIncomingData = false
+  } else {
+    useIncomingData =
+      (incomingState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0) > (existingState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+  }
+
+  const chosenData = useIncomingData
+    ? incomingState.data
+    : existingState.data
+  const chosenDataUpdatedAt = useIncomingData
+    ? (incomingState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+    : (existingState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+  const chosenDataUpdateCount = useIncomingData
+    ? (incomingState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0)
+    : (existingState.dataUpdateCount ?? 0)
+
+  const existingHasError = existingState.error != null
+  const incomingHasError = incomingState.error != null
+
+  let useIncomingError: boolean
+  if (incomingHasError && !existingHasError) {
+    useIncomingError = true
+  } else if (!incomingHasError && existingHasError) {
+    useIncomingError = false
+  } else if (incomingHasError && existingHasError) {
+    useIncomingError =
+      (incomingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0) > (existingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+  } else {
+    useIncomingError = false
+  }
+
+  const chosenError = useIncomingError
+    ? incomingState.error
+    : existingHasError
+      ? existingState.error
+      : null
+  const chosenErrorUpdatedAt = useIncomingError
+    ? (incomingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+    : existingHasError
+      ? (existingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+      : Math.max(
+          existingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0,
+          incomingState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0,
+        )
+  const chosenErrorUpdateCount = useIncomingError
+    ? (incomingState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0)
+    : existingHasError
+      ? (existingState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0)
+      : Math.max(
+          existingState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0,
+          incomingState.errorUpdateCount ?? 0,
+        )
+  const chosenFetchFailureCount = useIncomingError
+    ? (incomingState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0)
+    : existingHasError
+      ? (existingState.fetchFailureCount ?? 0)
+      : 0
+  const chosenFetchFailureReason = useIncomingError
+    ? (incomingState.fetchFailureReason ?? null)
+    : existingHasError
+      ? (existingState.fetchFailureReason ?? null)
+      : null
+
+  let status: QueryStatus
+  if (chosenError != null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (chosenData !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = 'pending'
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...existingState,
+    ...incomingState,
+    data: chosenData,
+    dataUpdatedAt: chosenDataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount: chosenDataUpdateCount,
+    error: chosenError,
+    errorUpdatedAt: chosenErrorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount: chosenErrorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount: chosenFetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason: chosenFetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta: incomingState.fetchMeta ?? existingState.fetchMeta ?? null,
+    isInvalidated:
+      Boolean(existingState.isInvalidated) ||
+      Boolean(incomingState.isInvalidated),
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
